title: On Arc-Transitive Regular Covers of Cubic Edge-Primitive Graphs
summary: We determine, up to isomorphism of the covering graphs, the connected arc-transitive regular covers of cubic edge-primitive graphs whose covering transformation group is cyclic or elementary abelian of order $p^2$, where $p$ is a prime. Combining the known classifications for the base graphs ${\rm K_{3,3}}$ and ${\rm DC_{14}}$ with new arguments for ${\rm F30A}$ and ${\rm F102A}$ gives the full list in these two classes of covering groups.
